title: Follow one request through a governed AI system
case: A customer's order arrived damaged. Resolve the request without exceeding the system's authority.
disclaimer: Teaching simulation. Every record, policy, name and event is synthetic. Nothing here calls a model or a real service, and the gates in the drawing represent enforcement; they do not enforce anything.

interventions.label: Remove supporting evidence
interventions.help: Retrieval finds no policy passage that covers this case.

interventions.label: Omit saved notes
interventions.help: The earlier-session note with the damage photos is not loaded.

interventions.label: Deny the refund permission
interventions.help: The agent's identity is not granted refunds:issue.

interventions.label: Make the refund service fail
interventions.help: The Refunds service returns an error on every attempt.

interventions.label: Customer withdraws the request
interventions.help: A cancellation arrives after the order is looked up.

interventions.label: Tighten the step budget
interventions.help: The run may use only 4 model calls and tool executions.

completed.label: Verified completion
completed.text: The application checked the success criteria against service records: refund RF-2207 issued for $84.00 within policy, customer notified.

waiting_input.label: Waiting for input
waiting_input.text: The run stopped safely and asked a person for what it lacks. Nothing irreversible happened.

denied.label: Denied before execution
denied.text: The enforcement point refused the operation before it reached the Refunds service. The proposal was handed to a person with its evidence.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.text: The customer withdrew the request. Pending work was dropped; nothing had been executed that needs undoing.

budget.label: Budget exhausted
budget.text: The run used its step budget before the goal was verified. It stopped and handed off its progress. A bounded exit, not a success.

failed.label: Operational failure
failed.text: The Refunds service failed on both permitted attempts. The run stopped, logged the error and handed off. No third attempt.

request.title: A customer asks for help
request.narration: The customer reports that order A-1042 arrived with a cracked lamp base. The application creates a run with a goal owned by the support operations lead.

assemble.title: The application sets the desk
assemble.narration: Context is assembled for the first model call: standing instructions and the request. Nothing else is on the desk yet.

procedure.title: A procedure card is selected
procedure.narration: The skill description 'damaged item' matches, so the application loads the Damaged item procedure v3. It is guidance for this task, not a worker and not a permission.

note.title: A relevant earlier note is loaded
note.narration: Memory holds an entry from this customer's earlier session: two photos of the cracked base, uploaded 29 September. It is relevant, permitted for this customer and recent, so it goes on the desk.

note_missing.title: No earlier note on the desk
note_missing.narration: Saved notes are omitted for this run. The photos exist in the earlier session, but the model cannot use what is not placed in its context.

model_get_order.title: The model proposes a lookup
model_get_order.narration: The model reads the desk and proposes a tool call. It does not run the call. The response ends with stop_reason tool_use, which says why this response stopped, nothing more.

authz_read.title: The read is checked and allowed
authz_read.narration: The application validates the arguments and checks the agent identity's scopes: orders:read is granted. Allowed.

exec_get_order.title: The Orders service answers
exec_get_order.narration: Through its MCP client the host calls tools/call on the Orders server. The record comes back and is added to the desk for the next model call.

cancel_received.title: The customer withdraws the request
cancel_received.narration: A cancellation arrives before any write. The run drops its pending work. Nothing was executed that needs undoing.

retrieve.title: The policy passage is retrieved
retrieve.narration: The application searches the policy library for this case. Returns policy v7 section 4.2 comes back with its provenance and goes on the desk.

evidence.text: Items damaged in transit: refund up to the item price when photo evidence is provided. Refunds over $50 need a supervisor's approval.

retrieve_empty.title: Nothing relevant comes back
retrieve_empty.narration: The search returns no passage that covers damage in transit. The desk has no policy support for a refund.

work_order.title: The coordinator writes a work order
work_order.narration: Instead of searching policy itself, the coordinator delegates. The work order carries a question and three facts. It does not carry the conversation, the customer's contact details or any credentials.

workOrder.task: Is order A-1042 eligible for a damage refund, and does it need approval?

spec_retrieve.title: The specialist checks the policy
spec_retrieve.narration: The policy specialist has its own context: the work order and what it fetches. Its only configured tool is retrieve_policy. It finds section 4.2.

spec_retrieve_empty.title: The specialist finds nothing
spec_retrieve_empty.narration: The specialist searches with its one tool and finds no passage covering this case.

spec_return.title: A compact result comes back
spec_return.narration: The specialist returns a structured result with its evidence, not its working. The coordinator adds it to its own desk alongside the order record.

evidence.text: Items damaged in transit: refund up to the item price when photo evidence is provided. Refunds over $50 need a supervisor's approval.

spec_return_empty.title: The specialist reports no support
spec_return_empty.narration: The result says so plainly: no covering policy found. That is a useful answer; inventing one would not be.

model_escalate.title: No support, so no refund proposal
model_escalate.narration: With no policy on the desk, the model does not propose a refund. It proposes handing the case to a person with a summary.

exec_handoff_owner.title: Handed to the policy owner
exec_handoff_owner.narration: The handoff is allowed and created. The run waits for a person to decide. No refund was attempted.

model_ask_photos.title: Missing evidence, so it asks
model_ask_photos.narration: Policy needs photo evidence and none is on the desk. The model proposes asking the customer for photos instead of refunding.

exec_ask.title: The customer is asked for photos
exec_ask.narration: Sending a message is allowed. The run pauses until the customer replies.

model_refund.title: The model proposes a refund
model_refund.narration: Order, note and policy are on the desk. The model proposes issue_refund for $84.00 and cites its evidence. It is still only a proposal.

authz_refund_deny.title: Denied before execution
authz_refund_deny.narration: The enforcement point checks the agent identity: refunds:issue is not granted. The call never reaches the Refunds service. The allowed next route is a handoff.

exec_handoff_denied.title: The proposal goes to a person
exec_handoff_denied.narration: A handoff with the proposed refund and its evidence is created for the support team. The run ends: denied, not failed and not succeeded.

authz_refund_approval.title: Allowed, but approval required
authz_refund_approval.narration: refunds:issue is granted, but the amount is over $50, so the rule routes this operation to a human approver before execution.

approval_granted.title: A supervisor approves
approval_granted.narration: The duty supervisor sees the exact operation, the order record and the policy passage, and approves. The decision is recorded and returns through the gate.

exec_refund.title: The refund is issued
exec_refund.narration: The approved call goes to the Refunds server with an idempotency key. The result comes back to the desk.

exec_refund_error.title: The Refunds service fails
exec_refund_error.narration: Attempt 1 of 2 returns an error. Because the call carries an idempotency key, one retry is safe.

exec_refund_retry.title: One bounded retry, which also fails
exec_refund_retry.narration: Attempt 2 of 2 fails the same way. The retry limit is reached; there is no third attempt.

handoff_failure.title: Stopped and handed off
handoff_failure.narration: The run logs the failure and hands the approved refund to a person to complete when the service recovers.

model_reply.title: The model drafts the reply
model_reply.narration: With the refund result on the desk, the model proposes a reply to the customer.

exec_reply.title: The reply is sent
exec_reply.narration: Sending is allowed and the message goes out. A sent message cannot be unsent, which is why it comes after the refund succeeded.

verify.title: The application verifies the goal
verify.narration: The model's last response ended with end_turn. That is not the success signal. The application checks the criteria against records: refund issued, amount within policy, customer notified.

budget_exhausted.title: The step budget runs out
budget_exhausted.narration: The next step would exceed the run's budget. The run stops and hands off what it has. A bounded exit, not a success.
